# Generation 7 — Gevurah Risk Critique

The Awtsmoos pours infinite light, yet truthful borders guard the flame;
Awtsmoos.com must never index private worlds, invent domain truth, or confuse two hosts as one name.

## Hard constraints

1. Never force comments into sitemap if the public renderer cannot resolve them.
2. Never hard-code 19 comment IDs; repair the shared invariant.
3. Never trust raw `Host` blindly for canonical generation.
4. Never override explicit authored canonical/robots metadata unless invalid or unsafe.
5. Never index preview/editor/admin/auth/private project surfaces.
6. Never assume a custom domain is primary merely because a request reached it; use verified routing metadata where available.
7. Never expose account/email/private owner metadata in JSON-LD.
8. Never create a global sitemap for user sites unless route enumeration is authoritative and bounded.
9. Preserve unrelated concurrent-agent work and current origin/main.
10. Whole-file rewrites only; no partial patch operations.
11. Every touched source file must remain modular and <=120 lines where feasible.
12. Test with the real canonical DosDB when dynamic entities are involved.

## Architecture preference

- Shared resolver/predicate for comment sitemap and public renderer.
- Shared HTML SEO enrichment module at the final public-host response boundary.
- Small pure helpers for host normalization, canonical choice, metadata extraction, and semantic injection.
- Routing adapter supplies trusted public-origin context; enrichment module never reads secrets or mutates non-HTML responses.
